rwf 0.1.0
  • Reference

    compute standard scores

    compute_standard.Rd

    compute standard scores

    compute_standard(vector, mean = 0, sd = 1, type = "z", input = "non_standard")

    Arguments

    vector

    vector

    mean

    numeric applicable to "uz"

    sd

    numeric applicable to "uz"

    type

    "z" "uz" "sten" "t" "stanine" "center" "center_reversed" "percent" "percentile" "scale_zero_one" "normal_density" "cumulative_density" "all"

    input

    "standard" "non_standard" standard inputs are z scores and non standard are raw scores

    Examples

    vector<-c(rnorm(10),NA,rnorm(10))
compute_standard(vector,type="z")
#>  [1]  1.2800617  1.2595127 -0.5093531  0.4555107  0.3294185 -1.2158177
#>  [7]  0.9908949 -1.4385837 -0.8447783  1.1580067         NA -0.2150299
#> [13]  0.0744687 -1.1794970 -1.0269639  0.5805701  0.1117861 -0.2601330
#> [19] -0.9226393 -0.7114428  2.0840086
compute_standard(vector,mean=0,sd=1,type="uz")
#>  [1]  1.13496509  1.11193185 -0.87077763  0.21073159  0.06939565 -1.66264885
#>  [7]  0.81083998 -1.91234580 -1.24675343  0.99815445          NA -0.54087274

#> [19] -1.33402726 -1.09729850  2.03610361
compute_standard(vector,type="sten")

compute_standard(vector,type="t")

compute_standard(vector,type="center")

#>  [7]  1.11068722 -1.61249856 -0.94690619  1.29800168          NA -0.24102551

compute_standard(vector,type="center_reversed")

compute_standard(vector,type="percent")
#>  [1]  55.742011  54.610769 -42.766863  10.349748   3.408257 -81.658362
#>  [7]  39.823120 -93.921831 -61.232318  49.022773         NA -26.564107
#> [13] -10.626954 -79.658878 -71.261794  17.234375  -8.572596 -29.047071
#> [19] -65.518633 -53.892076 100.000000
compute_standard(vector,type="scale_zero_one")
#>  [1] 0.77177407 0.76594058 0.26379170 0.53769902 0.50190372 0.06323924
#>  [7] 0.68968486 0.00000000 0.16857057 0.73712487         NA 0.34734472
#> [13] 0.42952811 0.07355001 0.11685140 0.57320110 0.44012185 0.33454078
#> [19] 0.14646725 0.20642212 1.00000000
ndf<-compute_standard(seq(-6,6,.01),mean=0,sd=1,type="normal_density")
plot(ndf)

cdf<-compute_standard(ndf,mean=0,sd=1,type="cumulative_density")
plot(cdf)
